events.content:
The migration is complete and the build passes cleanly. Here's a summary of everything that was done:

## Migration Summary

### Removed
- `pages/` directory (entirely deleted)
- `components/AppProvider.js` (replaced by `.tsx` version)

### Created (App Router structure)

| New File | Replaces | Key Changes |
|---|---|---|
| `app/layout.tsx` | `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | Root layout with `<html>`/`<body>`, `Metadata` export, Google Fonts in `<head>`, AppProvider wrapper |
| `app/page.tsx` | `pages/index.js` | Async server component; `headers()` from `next/headers` replaces `req.headers`; `cache: "no-store"` replaces `getServerSideProps`; `Metadata` export replaces `<Head>` |
| `app/view-all-posts-button.tsx` | (inline in index.js) | Extracted `"use client"` component for `useRouter().push()` |
| `app/blog/page.tsx` | `pages/blog/index.js` | `next: { revalidate: 60 }` replaces `getStaticProps` + ISR; `Link` replaces `<a>` tags |
| `app/blog/read-more-button.tsx` | (inline in blog/index.js) | Extracted `"use client"` component for `useRouter().push()` |
| `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `pages/blog/[id].js` | `generateStaticParams` replaces `getStaticPaths`; `generateMetadata` replaces `<Head>`; `notFound()` replaces `notFound: true`; `revalidate = 300` for ISR; `params` is `Promise<>` |
| `app/blog/[id]/back-button.tsx` | (inline in blog/[id].js) | Extracted `"use client"` component for `useRouter().back()` |
| `app/not-found.tsx` | `pages/404.js` | App Router `not-found` convention; `Metadata` export |
| `app/error.tsx` | `pages/_error.js` | `"use client"` error boundary with `reset()` function |
| `app/go-home-button.tsx` | (inline in 404.js) | Extracted `"use client"` component |
| `app/api/posts/route.ts` | `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `GET`/`POST` named exports using `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` |
| `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE` named exports; `params` is `Promise<>` |
| `components/AppProvider.tsx` | `components/AppProvider.js` | `"use client"` directive; full TypeScript types |

### Key API replacements
- `next/head` `<Head>` → `Metadata` / `generateMetadata` exports
- `next/router` `useRouter` → `next/navigation` `useRouter`
- `getServerSideProps` → async server component + `cache: "no-store"`
- `getStaticProps` + `revalidate` → `fetch` with `next: { revalidate }` / segment-level `revalidate` export
- `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams` + `dynamicParams`
- `getInitialProps` → `"use client"` error boundary with `error`/`reset` props
- Pages Router API routes (`handler(req, res)`) → Route Handlers (`GET`/`POST`/etc. named exports)
- `Html`/`Head`/`Main`/`NextScript` from `next/document` → root layout `<html>`/`<body>`

| `app/api/posts/route.ts` | `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `GET`/`POST` named exports using `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` |
| `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE` named exports; `params` is `Promise<>` |
| `components/AppProvider.tsx` | `components/AppProvider.js` | `"use client"` directive; full TypeScript types |

### Key API replacements
- `next/head` `<Head>` → `Metadata` / `generateMetadata` exports
- `next/router` `useRouter` → `next/navigation` `useRouter`
- `getServerSideProps` → async server component + `cache: "no-store"`
- `getStaticProps` + `revalidate` → `fetch` with `next: { revalidate }` / segment-level `revalidate` export
- `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams` + `dynamicParams`
- `getInitialProps` → `"use client"` error boundary with `error`/`reset` props
- Pages Router API routes (`handler(req, res)`) → Route Handlers (`GET`/`POST`/etc. named exports)
- `Html`/`Head`/`Main`/`NextScript` from `next/document` → root layout `<html>`/`<body>`
